consequence.statement: The option was unused, so removing it has no operational effect; any value set for it is no longer a recognised option.

original.statement: The unused Helm value proxy.sidecarImageRegex has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.

decision.reason: [ev-3fb29eea728d] calls the Helm option `proxy.sidecarImageRegex` "unused" when it says it was removed. A value that was never used was never honoured, so setting-ignored would over-claim mandatory work. The values diff [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5] only confirms that the key is gone. Nothing in the evidence says that leaving the key set fails or is rejected, so the "none"/informational consequence holds.
